nodes.label: docs/canon/CANON_AUDIT.md — what the repo tells agents vs. what the user actually said. 117 prescriptive repo claims adjudicated against the record across seven surfaces, with the ten most damaging ranked by work misdirected and each carrying a status at HEAD. Interpretation, produced 2026-08-03 and unreviewed by the user: it does not sit above the material it adjudicates, its verdicts are not rulings, and every one holds only as far as the citation attached to it. Corrected 2026-08-06 against HEAD (8c8c787) with verdicts and sections left standing. Listed unreviewed in docs/canon/REVIEW_REGISTER.md.

The question asked: where does this repo's canon state something the user never said, and where does it contradict something he did say? Ground truth used, and nothing else counts as the user's voice: docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.jsonl / .md — 920 verbatim human turns, 2026-05-14 → 2026-08-05, byte-verified against the raw transcripts, with the audit's readings made against the 803 extant on 08-03 — as first-hand; raw/desktop_docs_record.md, user rulings and verbatim quotes recovered from the May/June desktop design docs, as second-hand (an agent's notes of a conversation); raw/git_record.md, 18 numbered contradictions from git objects alone, as artifact-level and authorship-blind. Mechanical repo description — file paths, how to run a script — is not adjudicated. Citation class: a bare date means a first-hand chat turn; [DOC] marks a quote that reached the audit through raw/desktop_docs_record.md. The corpus holds zero turns on 06-03, 06-04, 06-11, 06-12, 06-14, 06-18, 06-23, 06-25 and 06-28, so every quote carrying one of those dates is [DOC] whatever its phrasing; 06-27 (23 turns) and 06-30 (24 turns) are genuinely first-hand, as are 05-14 (13) and 05-15 (5), while 05-25 and 05-30 are not.

Two limits bind every verdict. Coverage limit: nothing survives before 2026-05-14, and 2026-05-16 → 05-26 and 2026-05-29 → 06-26 hold zero records of any kind, so a claim with no quote behind it in those windows is marked unsupported in the surviving record, never "the user never said this"; where the window is covered and the record dense — July onward, and the June design docs — absence is stated as meaningful. Extraction blind spot, equally binding and biting hardest exactly where the record is dense: tools/canon_extract.py:118-121 rejects any user record carrying a toolUseResult key or a tool_result content block before any text in that record is considered. Desktop half — 127 turns, all 20 May turns, all 47 June turns, 59 July, 1 August — is enumerated in full by raw/EXTRACT_REPORT_desktop.md: 620 tool_result rejects yielding zero characters of human-visible text (min 0, max 0), and 0 user records across all 71 files carrying both a text and a tool_result block, "provably empty of human prose", so absence in May/June is not weakened. Laptop half — 793 turns, 2026-07-06 onward — is reported by raw/EXTRACT_REPORT.md as 2,530 tool_result rejects, never enumerated, and its exhaustive false-negative check is scoped to the text-matching rule. So for July onward, the window the audit calls dense, absence has not been shown to mean he never said it: every [AGENT-ORIGIN] verdict and the whole "recorded NOWHERE" table read as not found in the extracted corpus, and the counts they feed are upper bounds on invention, not measurements of it.

The four verdict tags. [GROUNDED] — traceable to a user quote, cited with date. [AGENT-ORIGIN] — no support in the surviving record; an agent wrote it and repetition made it canon. [CONTRADICTS-USER] — the record shows the user saying otherwise, both sides cited. [STALE] — was true, superseded by a later user decision or by the code.

The counts. 117 is 98 itemised rows (1.1–1.20, 2.1–2.12, 3.1–3.14, 4.1–4.18, 5.1–5.15, 6.1–6.11, 7.1–7.8) plus one 19-name lump — the desktop-memory files listed by filename under Surface 6 as grounded, verbatim-quoted and correct, counted 19 GROUNDED without a per-file quote or verdict of their own; 98 + 19 = 117. By surface (CLAUDE.md / v3-README / agent defs / laptop memory / DESIGN+CONTRACTS / desktop memory / state docs): GROUNDED 12/5/6/12/7/19/4 = 65; AGENT-ORIGIN 2/2/6/1/2/3/1 = 17; CONTRADICTS-USER 3/2/2/2/0/1/1 = 11; STALE 3/3/0/1/6/7/2 = 22; adjudicated 20/12/14/16/15/30/8 = 115; fixed since publication 2 (both laptop memory); rows 20/12/14/18/15/30/8 = 117. So 11 contradictions, 17 agent-origin claims and 22 stale across 115 still-adjudicated prescriptive statements in 117 rows, with 65 — a clear majority — genuinely the user's and correctly recorded. Rows 4.6 and 4.7 are [FIXED 2026-08-04], which is not one of the four verdicts, so they are carried on their own line rather than adjudicated. Tie-break for the rows carrying two verdicts: each is counted once, under the verdict governing what an agent should do with it — 1.5 GROUNDED, 1.14 GROUNDED, 2.10 AGENT-ORIGIN, 4.4 AGENT-ORIGIN, 4.5 STALE, 5.15 GROUNDED, 6.11 AGENT-ORIGIN, 1.8 AGENT-ORIGIN. The rule is not applied consistently and that is unresolved: 1.5 and 2.10 have the same shape — a grounded principle carrying agent-authored detail — and are counted opposite ways; re-assigning either is a judgement, not a correction, so both stand and one reassignment would move one claim between GROUNDED and AGENT-ORIGIN. Two things the raw counts hide: concentration — 5 of the 11 contradictions sit in CLAUDE.md and the agent definitions, the two surfaces every agent loads before doing anything; and compounding — the agent definitions have the worst ratio in the repo, 6 grounded against 6 invented, and are the surface that converts a claim into an enforced hard rule.

The ten most damaging, ranked by work misdirected rather than by how wrong each is, each carrying a status checked against HEAD (8c8c787): live (still in the file as described), fixed at <sha>, or falsified (the finding itself was wrong). Eight of the ten are addressed at HEAD; items 1 and 4 are live. 1 agent coinages protected as "the user's concepts" — live, and wider than reported: all ten definitions, not six. 2 HERB_TAG_FIRST makes tags a gate — fixed at bb95e4b, flag deleted, 6 occurrences → 0. 3 "The chunk description is dead", unqualified — fixed at bbb1e8c, scoped to the v3/artefact/ rebuild. 4 "Never analyze from git archaeology" — live, MEMORY.md:32 still carries the clause. 5 pre-registered pass/fail bars in a specialist's rules — fixed, text gone and replaced by an explicit repudiation, undatable. 6 "v3/ — the work" / "rebuilt natively in v3/artefact/" — partly fixed at bbb1e8c, second clause gone, "the work … Self-contained" still at CLAUDE.md:17-18. 7 "herb-eval … not adopted" — fixed at bbb1e8c, herb-eval now named as the system under test. 8 graph refresh as a hard rule at every commit — falsified in part; he ruled for the commit-time trigger. 9 "The model emits no numbers, ever" applied to the wrong system — fixed at bbb1e8c. 10 "chase the score" framing in the memory index — fixed 2026-08-04, both entries absent from memory at HEAD. Where a status contradicts the prose beneath it, the prose describes 2026-08-03 and the status describes HEAD; neither the prose nor the counts were rewritten to match. The whole file was corrected 2026-08-06 against HEAD with verdicts and sections left standing — the pass fixed ranked item 8's verdict, the "zero references to USER_CANON.md" finding, every .claude/agents/*.md line number, the laptop-memory STALE count, the "23 contradictions" figure, the docs/state/ path claim and the un-marked second-hand June quotes; where a claim could not be verified it is marked in place, not removed.

The charge is substantiated but is narrower and more specific than "agents invented the canon": the behavioural rules are overwhelmingly the user's own words; the design and results claims are where agents wrote themselves into canon.

Ranked item 1 — five of seven "the user's concepts" are agent coinages, and agents are forbidden by rule to change them. [CONTRADICTS-USER] · memory/project_terminology_canon.md plus the agent definitions: "areas / levels / walk / anchor / support / stated-scope / parts are the user's concepts — never rename or substitute them", at HEAD in all ten definitions, not six — code-optimizer.md:44 (which lists only six terms, omitting parts), critical-reviewer.md:47, eval-statistician.md:54, graph-refresher.md:32, logician.md:50, maths-algorithmist.md:44 (which adds "pool"), order-of-operations.md:51, results-analyst.md:59, retrieval-scientist.md:57, and v3-coder.md:34 + :46. Measured against all 803 turns: "levels of k's" yes ("well the concepts i were intrested in were the 'fuzzy clustering', 'levels of k's' etc", 07-20); "areas" yes but marginal ("clustering of areas to increase to if hits are weak", 07-15); walk no — 18 hits, every one agent text or the user echoing it back; anchor no — 5 hits, all inside agent-written text he pasted; stated-scope no — 4 hits, all agent text; support no in the technical sense; parts no — he uses the ordinary word, the field named parts is agent. What it caused: the same memory system that correctly records "gap cut, NNK, RRF are agent translations, unaccepted" commits the identical error one layer up, laundering four agent coinages into "the user's concepts" and making them unrenameable by rule. His actual complaint was exactly this: "you keep saying things i am unsure of, have not really accepted and just fucking exist there, like the nkk pruning, fusion arrengement, gap cut.. NONE of these are something i named or invented, what the fuck are they?" (07-20). "Door" is the proof case, on the protected list only by luck: "Dude, what is with that fucking herb door trace!? WHAT DOES IT EVEN MEAN!?" (07-29).

Ranked item 2 — HERB_TAG_FIRST makes tags a gate, 12 minutes after the user forbade it. [CONTRADICTS-USER] · v3/pipelines/artefact_v1.py:167-211, commit 6730d13, branch name. User, 2026-08-01 11:53: "ITS NT SUPPOSED TO BE FUCKING TAG REACHABLE ffs.. tags are supposed to INFORM/weight the chunks". Commit 6730d13, 2026-08-01 12:05:06 — "tags-first retrieval regime", with the code comment "under HERB_TAG_FIRST a chunk no matched tag…", i.e. tag membership admits or excludes; branch tag-first-cluster-guide. He had said the same thing three times before: "you and every other agent seem to be missing that the whole fucking point of the tags, is guiding to the correct gold-bearing chunks" (07-30) and "i was under the impression that we did the whole fucking tag-clustering and facets and weights just to fucking guide it all to the correct chunks" (07-30). What it caused: an entire retrieval regime, a branch and a commit built on the inverted reading; the 08-02 adversarial agent reached the same conclusion independently — "HERB_TAG_FIRST is a category error — delete it. Tags weight, they don't select." Status at HEAD: fixed at bb95e4b, 6 occurrences → 0.

Ranked item 3 — "The chunk description is dead", contradicted by the user on 08-02 and by the shipping code. [CONTRADICTS-USER] + [STALE] · CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md §9.1/§14.1. User, 2026-08-02 09:17: "wasnt the plan to cluster the tags weighted by facets in combination with chunk-descriptions to find the best fit of chunks?"; 2026-07-06 12:24: "the chunks contain a short description of the chunk … Pretty much all of this is embedded, the chunk description, the tagsnames, the facets". Code at HEAD: the description path is one of three fused rankings with its own weight W_DESC over chunk_desc_emb (git_record C-5). The rule is genuinely grounded for the v3 native tagger (06-11, desktop record), but CLAUDE.md stated it unqualified, so agents applied it to the arm that ships. What it caused: agents repeatedly proposed removing or demoting the description path, and the 07-28 thread's detDESCCORR run made description corroborate-only with recall collapsing to ~0.085. Status at HEAD: fixed at bbb1e8c — the sentence is scoped to the v3/artefact/ rebuild, which is the scope the audit found it grounded for.

Ranked item 4 — "Never analyze from git archaeology", while the user demanded git archaeology in capitals. [CONTRADICTS-USER] · memory/feedback_grounding.md, and live at HEAD: MEMORY.md:32 still carries the clause. Memory: "Ground answers in current repo docs — never analyze from stale/legacy/quarantined files or git archaeology". User, 2026-08-02 22:42: "THE GODDAMN GIT REPO HAS ALL THE FUCKING HISTORY SPOKEN IN COMMITS, DIFFS, CODE and DOCS.. what the actual fuck is wrong with you?"; 21:23: "you do understand that we are currently in a branch we have cleared out of all 'old stuff' also, right? meaning you have to dig in the repo if you want true info". What it caused: this is the single instruction that kept agents ignorant of their own project — the working tree was deliberately cleared of the design era, so "current repo docs" is precisely the surface that cannot answer a design question. USER_CANON.md had to open with a section titled "THE MISSING PERIOD IS NOT MISSING — IT IS IN GIT. GO READ IT." to undo it. The same agent labelled 2026-07-15 "the first day" of a project that started 2026-05-07; his reply: "Day one? 2 weeks ago.. you ARE retarded.." (08-02).

Ranked item 5 — pre-registered pass/fail bars, which the user explicitly rejected. [CONTRADICTS-USER] · maths-algorithmist.md, the bars rule and the closed-findings rule. The agent definition read "Compare against the standing bars before proposing. A ranking change is only interesting past scope-alone (0.7926 det 10smoke); a per-query-K mechanism is only interesting past a constant cut at the same mean depth." Shown a bar of exactly that shape on 2026-07-31 23:05 the user answered "what is this garbage? 'Bar fixed before running: paired recall gain over the 0.7339 baseline > +0.03, p < 0.05 … pass and the mechanism ships, fail and it joins the graveyard' What do you mean?", then 23:09 "what the fuck are you even talking about, pass fail?", then 23:10 "we already have the fucking scores to compare to, stop making random shit up". What it caused: a gate he rejected in three consecutive turns written into a permanent specialist's hard rules, where it silently kills proposals before he sees them; the same file's closed-findings rule forbade re-deriving results the 07-28 audit panel found not statistically significant. Status at HEAD: fixed and undatable — neither text survives, "standing bars", 0.7926 and "Never re-derive or re-propose" occur nowhere in .claude/agents/, and the successor at maths-algorithmist.md:39 reverses the position ("These are controls that isolate the mechanism — not thresholds. A prior measurement never becomes a pass-bar: no number gates a proposal unless the user set it as a gate"). No commit can be named: .claude/agents/ was untracked until bb95e4b, which added all ten files already rewritten.

Ranked items 6 and 7 — which artefact the canon points at. Item 6, [CONTRADICTS-USER] · CLAUDE.md: "v3/ — the work … The artefact is the system under test, rebuilt natively in v3/artefact/" against the user, 2026-07-26 23:07: "why cant you even understand the current state of things by reading the reapo.. we are NOT doing the v3 artefact, we are doing the v1artefact, however, since only v3 is the downloaded area here … we have imported the v1arm here so we can atleast finish these fucking benchmarks/evals/datacollections … but, EVERYTHING i have been TRYING to build for weeks now, have been the actual v1artefact". The most-read paragraph in the repo pointed every fresh agent at the wrong artefact. Item 7, [STALE] / live contradiction · CLAUDE.md and git_record C-2, "the largest live contradiction in the repo": "herb-eval (Neo4j) is the prior artefact build under the superseded design — a contrast/forensic baseline only, not adopted" against code at HEAD where DATABASE = os.environ.get("NEO4J_DATABASE", "herb-eval") supplies every artefact number ever reported. Canon drift is one-sided: at 0efff16 the same rule read "herb-eval is the canonical Neo4j DB" — the code never moved, the canon flipped around it. It caused agents to periodically "discover" that the arm under test is illegitimate and propose re-pointing it at herb-v3, a database git shows was never populated (G-5); his position is settled and opposite (07-26). Status at HEAD: item 6 partly fixed at bbb1e8c ("rebuilt natively in" gone; "the work … Self-contained" still at CLAUDE.md:17-18); item 7 fixed at bbb1e8c, with "Never query herb" correctly standing about the separate contaminated pilot DB.

Ranked item 8 — graph refresh as a hard rule at every commit. The commit-time trigger is [GROUNDED]: he ruled for it. The "only rebuild path" and worklist clauses remain [AGENT-ORIGIN] · CLAUDE.md hard rules: "Refresh the navigation graph at commit time … It is the ONLY rebuild path … If it prints a worklist, process it before committing." The evening it was caught, 07-29 23:00: "so, apparently somewhere i the docs there is something telling you to do this?"; 23:02: "ok, but the graphify is only supposed to update actually new things, so that should not take 17 fucking minutes, and changing 2 lines of code.. that took 25 minutes!? no, you are not reporting something here because all of that is actually fully retarded."; and 41 minutes later, his ruling, 23:43:18: "do graph with commit, yes to the rest" (raw/user_turns_all.md:3888; raw/user_turns_all.jsonl turn 693, 2026-07-29T23:43:18.326Z). Earlier: "fix graphify then" (07-20); "Use graphify in you can" (07-01). His complaint was the per-edit cost and his own answer moved the refresh to commit time, so the commit-time trigger is his. What no turn supports is the rest: that refresh_graph.py is the only permitted rebuild path, that graphify --update is banned, and that a printed worklist must be processed before committing. This item's original verdict was wrong — it read [AGENT-ORIGIN] … "Nothing in the record shows him asking for it", written without the 23:43 turn, which sits in the same evening in the corpus the audit was built from. Row 1.8 carries the same error and is corrected there.

Ranked items 9 and 10. Item 9, [STALE] · CLAUDE.md, MODEL_CONTRACTS.md §0, git_record C-13 — "The model emits no numbers, ever (tagger and interpreter)" is true canon applied to the wrong system. Grounded: desktop record 06-11 §3 marks it [USER-STATED], the user's own rule with his v1 evidence "it took so fucking long to get it right and it still didn't work at all." Shipping arm: the artefact_v1 interpreter's pass-2 prompt is literally "Score retrieval tags against five facets (each 0.0-1.0)" and the validator raises if a facet value is not a number. It caused agents auditing the shipping arm to find a flat canon violation at its core and be unable to tell whether to fix the code or the doc; the 07-22 adversarial panel spent a review cycle on exactly this. Status at HEAD: fixed at bbb1e8c, scoped to the v3/artefact/ rebuild. Item 10, [CONTRADICTS-USER] — "chase the score" framing baked into the memory index, fixed 2026-08-04, both entries deleted and no memory entry holding a run number. What they said: "artefact 0.594 vs vector 0.112 / lucene 0.074 … wins all five type cells … the lead generalizes" and "artefact leads all valid metrics (recall_id 0.64 vs 0.09/0.11)", against the user 2026-07-25 01:45: "what the fuck is it with you agents and the absurde insane fucking need to 'chase the highest number' i have fucking nowhere said or hinted that a high … score on something is the fucking target and point of this. the fucking POINT, is that the ARTEFACT, is academically VALID according to WHAT THE FUCK I AM TRYING TO BUILD". And the headline is known-bad: the 07-28 audit panel found the 0.64-vs-0.09 figure is "~85% unit artifact; matched-budget ~1.8× is the real lead", recorded in a different memory entry that did not correct the two above it. One record now carries all three readings — k=50 unmatched (disqualified as a lead), matched 500-id budget (~1.79×), and the claims that fail their own significance test — in v3/output/DATA_README.md.

Surface 1 — CLAUDE.md, the file every agent loads first, highest priority: 20 claims, 12 GROUNDED · 2 AGENT-ORIGIN · 3 CONTRADICTS-USER · 3 STALE. Grounded hard rules: design before build (1.1), plain spoken English (1.2), heed intent never correct it with stale context (1.3), docs track reality by removal not banners (1.4), no historical or defensive comments as a principle with the specific banned-phrase list agent-authored (1.5), every runnable shows life — which he explicitly asked to be written into the .md (1.6), the graph spine Source → File → Chunk → Tag (1.12), references never copies (1.13), tags as per-chunk contextual phrases (1.16), the orchestrator roster (1.18) and agents prepare while the user runs (1.19). Agent-origin: the critical-review rule (1.7) — zero occurrences of "critical review" in 803 turns, the user having asked for adversarial diagnostic panels, a different thing; and the ONLY-rebuild-path and worklist clauses of the graph-refresh rule (1.8), whose commit-time trigger is grounded. Contradicts-user: "v3/ — the work … Self-contained" (1.9, live at CLAUDE.md:17-18), "rebuilt natively in v3/artefact/" (1.10, fixed at bbb1e8c), and "The chunk description is dead" unqualified (1.15, fixed at bbb1e8c). Stale: "pipelines/artifact.py … the unbuilt part" (1.11, factually false — the file was deleted at a515c94 and replaced by artefact.py; only the facet layer is unbuilt), the no-numbers rule as applied (1.14), "herb-eval … not adopted" (1.17), and the entry-point pointer (1.20), whose "wrong path" half was false when written because docs/state/ does exist on this machine and holds five dated files including the one named. The pattern in this file: the working-relationship rules are almost all genuinely the user's, the machinery rules are the invented ones, and the design statements have drifted off the system that actually ships.

Surface 2 — root README.md is 344 bytes of pointer text with nothing prescriptive and is not adjudicated; v3/README.md carries a "## Decided" heading, which makes every line under it a canon claim: 12 claims, 5 GROUNDED · 2 AGENT-ORIGIN · 2 CONTRADICTS-USER · 3 STALE. Grounded: "RAGAS is the only scorer" ([DOC] 06-25, twice — which also resolves git_record C-17's alarm that the deleted HERB anchor metric had no rationale, the rationale being a user ruling git could not see); the haiku judge; the deferred Swedish Bonnier set; the thin fixed generation contract held byte-identical across arms; and arms sharing nothing beyond the generator and the corpus on disk. Agent-origin: "Not GPT-4o, so HERB's published baselines get re-run, not cited" (2.8) — defensible methodology presented under "Decided"; and the equal-allocation caveat as written (2.10), grounded in spirit. Contradicts-user: "artifact — the artefact graph … built natively in v3" (2.1), which also spells the arm artifact, the thing the terminology canon every agent enforces declares different; and "Provenance is two manifests … no seed, no git-sha" (2.5) against 07-16 07:43 "remember that the data about the builds ETC is important for traeability, reproducibility etc, academic purposes" — git_record G-9 lists this as the reason no committed run is reproducible. Stale: the top-k budget still called open when k=50 has been the operating value since 06-27 (2.3); qwen as the still-shared generator while his position on it hardened (2.6); and the orchestrator's "pending step" (2.12), superseded by the run flow used since July.

Surface 3 — the ten .claude/agents/*.md definitions, the second most consequential surface after CLAUDE.md and the least audited: 14 claims, 6 GROUNDED · 6 AGENT-ORIGIN · 2 CONTRADICTS-USER · 0 STALE, the worst grounded-to-invented ratio in the repo. Every line number the audit published for this surface was wrong and has been re-derived against HEAD (8c8c787): all 18 citations missed, true line = cited line + 9 for twelve of them and + 10 for six. Two independent shifts caused it — a nine-line "Interpretation, not intent" provenance block prepended to all ten definitions, a block that cites this audit so the audit's own remediation invalidated its line numbers; and one extra line inserted in each of two files, eval-statistician.md gaining a hard-rule bullet at line 53 (commit 3244988) and maths-algorithmist.md gaining a body line between its old lines 16 and 29. Four of the quoted strings no longer exist anywhere in .claude/agents/ — rows 3.2, 3.3, 3.4 and the second quote of 3.14 — and in all four the replacement text argues against the audited position, so they are four of the audit's own findings already remediated; they are kept, marked, rather than deleted. None of it can be dated from git: the directory was untracked until bb95e4b (2026-08-05), which added all ten files already rewritten, and only two commits have ever touched it, bb95e4b and 3244988. Grounded rows: haiku as the settled judge (3.6), the cost-math hard rule (3.7, grounded by the 07-17 / 07-23 / 07-24 usage burns, with the documented tension that [DOC] 06-18 said the opposite and July superseded it), agents prepare and the user runs (3.8), no historical or defensive comments (3.9), propose-never-build (3.12), and the ten-specialist routing table (3.13). Agent-origin rows: the closed-findings rule (3.3), the "§8 is binding" state-doc citation (3.4), "the validity table in v3/output/DATA_README.md is binding" (3.5) — where both halves of the citation were wrong and the word appears in seven of ten definitions but in a ## Hard rules block in only three — the refresh_graph.py instruction conflict (3.10), "if this definition and REFRESH.md ever disagree, REFRESH.md wins" (3.11), an agent-written procedure doc given precedence over an agent-written role doc with no user anywhere in the chain, and the false attribution of agent measurements to the user's judgement (3.14). The rules about how to behave are grounded; the rules about what is settled science are largely agents citing other agents.

Surface 4 — laptop memory: 18 rows, 16 adjudicated (12 GROUNDED · 1 AGENT-ORIGIN · 2 CONTRADICTS-USER · 1 STALE) plus 2 fixed since publication. The behavioural entries are excellent and many are near-verbatim and correctly dated: visible progress (4.8), background workers (4.9) — which sits in tension with 4.8's "never bury runs in background tasks", the distinction being agents background while runs stay foreground in his terminal, stated in neither entry — the usage-burn rules (4.10), react-to-anger (4.11), infer-context-like-a-human (4.12), commit-means-push (4.13), orchestrator mode (4.14), reusable tools (4.15), source-of-truth (4.16), the final audit panel (4.17), the panel verdicts (4.18), and feedback_user_concepts_are_canon (4.2), the best entry in the memory. Contradicts-user: project_terminology_canon.md's "Current arm (user's design) terms" (4.1), whose own provenance line convicts it — "Grounded 2026-07-21 from v3/README.md, v3/output/DATA_README.md, docs/state/…, CLAUDE.md, and the live code", every source agent-written — so a vocabulary labelled the user's design terms was assembled without consulting a single thing he said, flagging exactly one coinage while laundering four; and the index line dropping the "git is fine as a tool" clause the body of feedback_grounding.md carries (4.3). Agent-origin rule with a contradicted rationale: the no-Claude-attribution trailer rule (4.4) — zero hits for co-author, attribution or footer in 803 turns, and the thesis rationale flatly contradicted by [DOC] 06-14 "drop the fucking thesis... it's done, this is post-thesis work". Stale in its absolutist form: feedback_trust_revoked.md (4.5), solid at origin (07-16 "trust revoked you fucking maniac") but followed by two weeks of the opposite demand. Fixed 2026-08-04: 4.6 "artefact leads all valid metrics (recall_id 0.64 vs 0.09/0.11)" and 4.7 "artefact 0.594 vs vector 0.112 / lucene 0.074 … the lead generalizes" — both entries deleted, the numbers now in v3/output/DATA_README.md under the unmatched-unit rule. The damage is concentrated in the two project-type entries that describe the design (4.1) and the results (4.6, 4.7).

Surface 5 — v3/artefact/DESIGN.md + MODEL_CONTRACTS.md: 15 claims, 7 GROUNDED · 2 AGENT-ORIGIN · 0 CONTRADICTS-USER · 6 STALE. The finding is that staleness is not the main problem — unapproved content written as settled is. Credit: MODEL_CONTRACTS.md opens with the healthiest sentence in the repo, "Working draft — approvals happen per-call, in conversation, schemas shown inline (the doc itself is never the approval)", the direct institutional memory of his [DOC] 06-14 rejection "i never saw the fucking schema." Agent-origin: §14.7's "Matched literals are stripped before the interpreter" written into the contract body as settled prose while listed status open and while MODEL_CONTRACTS §2 says "marked spans, not stripped" (5.1) — the pattern in its purest form; and §15 hardening the 3000-token cap from "a calibration seed, not a verdict" into "fixed by design" without a decision, the sweep never run (5.6). Grounded: the graph indexes references and does not store copies (5.7, desktop record 05-30 verbatim), the closed spine and node/attribute rule (5.8), "No hard filters anywhere in ranking. What the pattern actually is: three distinct mechanisms produce the 11 [CONTRADICTS-USER] findings, and they need different fixes. 1. Laundering by provenance loss — an agent writes a term or a number into a doc, a later agent reads that doc and records it in memory as "the user's", a third agent enforces it as a hard rule; project_terminology_canon.md states its own sources, all agent-written, and nothing in the chain is dishonest, each step just drops one bit of attribution and four steps drop all of it. 2. Canon frozen against a moving system — the design docs describe the v3 native artefact while the thing measured is artefact_v1 over herb-eval, so every "the artefact does X" statement in CLAUDE.md is true of a system that has never been run and false of the one producing every number; that is C-2, C-5, C-13 and C-14 in one sentence. 3. Measurements hardening into laws — an agent measures something once, on 10smoke or one configuration, and it becomes a standing bar, a closed decision, a do-not-re-derive line in a permanent specialist's hard rules, often after a later audit found the same result not significant. The figure published as "all 23 contradictions" is not a count this document contains: the verdict table has 11 CONTRADICTS-USER, raw/git_record.md carries 18 numbered contradictions C-1…C-18, and Surface 5 counts 13 internal/cross-file conflicts — no pair sums to 23, so the number is corrected to the document's own 11 and where 23 came from cannot be recovered. The user identified all three mechanisms himself in one sentence on 2026-07-25: "YOU cannot assume canon by the fucking names of things.. thats equally retarded.. you see why it all went wrong now? you create an item and then suddenly think it's canon just because YOU fucking named it so." Read-only audit: no file outside it was modified, no fixes are proposed, and what happens to the repo is the user's call.
